title: Maximum Sync Queue Size Exceeded
body:
Hi Guys
I keep getting this queue size exceeded message. I can get rid of it by clearing all xdrip data (Settings - Apps - Xdrip - Storage - Clear Data) but I then have to set everything up again & error comes back a few weeks later. When the queue size is exceeded, followers don't get any data.
Screenshot of error log attached.
Any idea how I can stop this happening?

Thanks for your help.
Regards
Ali

![screenshot_20181016-165426_xdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24193604/47555247-3c9f4400-d903-11e8-82fb-4c7f69a38ca8.jpg)

comments.body:
I also have this issue.

I didn't have time to trace where it is coming from.
I do have AndroidWear enabled.
I do have could upload DISABLED.
I do have syncing with other xDrip instances DISABLED.

Edit: for some reason after exporting/importing setting and switching to new version this became enabled again. So no issue for me.
I see issue too, after receiving a calibration from Meter.
Check that you are not disabling background data access for xDrip
Background data is enabled for Xdrip
I see the same issue. Background data is enabled for Xdrip

I had it again on a follower recently. I had to Clear Data & set up again.
What's Nightscout Sync?

@alexmoir1
 Nightscout is a (free) online repository many of us upload out blood glucose readings to directly from xDrip.
If you look under hardware data source on your follower where you currently have selected xDrip+ Sync Follower, you will see another option called Nightscout Follower.
If you have Nightscout set up, and have set up the master to upload to it, you can select that on the follower.  The follower will show the readings and the master will never show the max sync queue error any more.

Will you consider it?
If you don't have a facebook account, I can ask and provide a link to a public document online that would walk you through the required setup.

Please tag me so that I get a notification.

These are instructions for setting up Nightscout.
http://nightscout.github.io/nightscout/new_user/?fbclid=IwAR3oa0QOlDnwCYr7VCm8Sv8SNZLDHdVRqUNZp9HbRl7WxSgHKQq_-68JsOE

They may look intimidating.  Believe me, it is worth it.  Do it when you can give it 20 minutes of time.  Don't expect to complete it in 2 minutes.
We're already set up as a Nightscout follower on Xdrip.

@alexmoir1 Can we close this issue?
Do you have any questions about what I suggested?
Hi, the master is Diabox. I'm just running xdrip as follower. Clearing data fixes the issue, but it's not very elegant. Feel free to close the issue.
